$comment: Historical stub, superseded. datasets/riskassessment_dataset/schema.json is authoritative for this dataset: it is the schema its entries are actually validated against (datasets/riskassessment_dataset/validate.py), and all 23 current entries pass it while all 23 fail this file. It diverged from this file in draft version (draft-07 to 2020-12, with additionalProperties false), assessment_id shape (RA-NNNN to a DSGAI-RA- slug), typed components with roles and sensitivity tiers instead of a string list, risks rated inherent and residual with a required rationale instead of a single risk_rating, structured existing_controls, control_gaps and framework_alignments instead of free text, an industry_sector enum instead of free-text industry, and new required fields (scenario_name, entry_type, deployment_pattern, description, date_added). This file is kept only so a $ref into it does not break; do not hand-edit it without also updating the dataset-local schema, and prefer editing the dataset-local one.
